subject: Private deployment architecture alignment — deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@cortexa.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC / air-gapped)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and infra teams reviewed the hosted options and we need to confirm feasibility for a private deployment (VPC with optional air-gap for archival workloads). Can we schedule a technical deep-dive next week to walk network boundaries, certificate/KMS flows, and ops runbook expectations?

Ideal attendees from our side: myself (ops), Priya Raman (infra), and our SecOps lead.

Attached is a short network summary and a checklist of items we’ll want to validate. We’re in PDT (San Francisco). Our preferred window: Tue/Wed 9:00–12:00 PDT.

Attachments: cortexa-network-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), initial-requirements.txt (text)

Thanks,
Matt Jensen
Ops Lead — Cortexa
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@cortexa.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC / air-gapped)

Hi Matt —

Appreciate the summary, got the attachment. Monica and Marcus will join from infra/solutions; Neha will cover security and KMS integrations. A couple of agenda items we’ll start with:

- Network boundary diagram and egress constraints
- KV cache and replication in an air-gapped scenario
- KMS/HSM keywrap and audit log flow
- Rollout plan: canary/testing and rollback playbook
- Pre-reqs for on-prem install and connectivity tests

I’m available Tue 10:30–11:30 PDT or Wed 09:00–11:00 PDT. If those don’t work, propose two slots and we’ll try to accommodate.

I’ll attach our VPC readiness checklist and a short pre-call questionnaire so we can triage items ahead of the call.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-vpc-checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@cortexa.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@cortexa.ai>, ops-lead@cortexa.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC / air-gapped)

Olga, thanks — quick note on availability. Wed 09:00–10:00 PDT would be perfect for our team. Could we narrow the agenda to emphasize two items to make the hour productive: network boundary/eBGP and KMS integration (including HSM options and audit retention)?

Also: our SecOps cannot do Wed before 09:30. If you can start at 09:30 and run to 10:30 PDT is that possible for you and your team?

We’ll fill out the questionnaire before the call.

—Matt

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick reply. We can do Wed 09:30–10:30 PDT — locking it in. I’ve created a calendar invite (see HubSpot link below) and attached a one-page runbook we’ll use to guide the discussion.

Please ensure the following before the call so we can keep within the 60-minute window:
- A person who can speak to eBGP/peer config or a network diagram with CIDR/BGP ASN details.
- KMS/HSM requirements (key rotation policy, BYOK details if any).
- Any regulatory constraints on log retention or data residency (a short note is fine).

Meeting logistics:
- Date/Time: Wed, Apr 23, 2025 09:30–10:30 PDT
- Location: Zoom (link in calendar invite)
- Attendees from Redwood: Olga Petrov, Monica Patel, Marcus Lin, Neha Kapoor
- Attendees from Cortexa: Matt Jensen, Priya Raman, SecOps lead

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0000000/company/4821/event/INV-9931
